caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Those 'people' you see online? Many could be 100% fake, invented by AI!

Here's how AI creates faces that never existed:
🔹 AI uses a clever "cat and mouse" game called GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks).
🔹 One AI generates fake faces, trying to fool the other AI which acts as a detective.
🔹 This constant challenge refines the AI, allowing it to create incredibly lifelike, unique faces.
🔹 These AI-generated individuals have unique features, expressions, and are almost impossible to distinguish from real photos!
